title: helianthemum arcticum
intro: Helianthemum arcticum, commonly known as Rockrose or Arctic Rockrose, is a perennial plant species native to the Arctic tundra. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Helianthemum arcticum include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
